content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near London’s O2 arena ignited a fire that destroyed a van and heavily damaged a car and lorry, prompting firefighters to respond to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before eight o’clock on Saturday evening; the blaze was brought under control after roughly an hour with twenty‑five crews on scene and no injuries reported, and authorities said the incident followed a pre‑planned filming activity at the location, which is also close to the venue’s upcoming concerts by Niall Horan and Texas, while the London Fire Brigade noted on social media that the fire stemmed from the explosion spreading beyond control, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman added that they were aware of reports of blasts heard in the vicinity of the O2 in Greenwich.
